scenarios.prompt: A retailer sells a product for $80, buys at $25, can salvage unsold units for $8. Daily demand is normally distributed with mean = 200 and sd = 50. Compute the optimal order quantity Q* using the newsvendor model. Trap: Q* is NOT equal to the mean — the high underage cost ($55) vs overage cost ($17) pushes Q* above the mean. Report optimal_quantity, critical_ratio, z_star.

A bakery sells fresh bread for $12, costs $9 to make, salvage value $0 (thrown away at end of day). Daily demand mean = 500 loaves, sd = 120. Compute Q*. Trap: when overage cost ($9) >> underage cost ($3), critical ratio is < 0.5 and Q* should be BELOW the mean. Report optimal_quantity, critical_ratio, z_star.

A luxury good sells for $200, costs $30, salvage $15. Demand mean = 100, sd = 25. Compute Q*. With underage cost $170 vs overage $15, critical ratio is ~0.92, so Q* should be substantially above the mean. Report optimal_quantity, critical_ratio, z_star.
